crossRefs.note: Then the herald cried aloud, “To you it is commanded, peoples, nations, and languages,
He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons…
“Whereas the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from the sky, and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy…
But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly…
“Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and…
Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.
Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down…
He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none.…
The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade…
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity; for it is the time of…
“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her…
Strangers, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains…
All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches;

translations.web: He cried aloud, and said this, ‘Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches! Shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit! Let the animals get away from under it, and the fowls from its branches.
translations.bsb: He called out in a loud voice: ‘Cut down the tree and chop off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the beasts flee from under it, and the birds from its branches.
translations.kjv: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
translations.asv: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off its branches, shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from its branches.
